caveat: fastify inject is Fastify's own request harness (light-my-request builds mock request/response streams per call), so its in-process column is not a pure router+validator figure; the find-my-way + Ajv + fast-json-stringify column is the same pieces with no harness, and the loopback table drives both stacks through real sockets. hono RegExpRouter REFUSES this route table and is reported instead of timed: Error: /api/enrichments/approve-all.
